# semaphore_ex_project_role (Resource)

Manages a custom Semaphore EX role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_project" "example" {
  name = "Role example"
}

resource "semaphore_ex_project_role" "viewer" {
  project_id          = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  name                = "Viewer"
  project_permissions = ["project.resources.view"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role display name.
- `project_id` (Number) Project owning this role.
- `project_permissions` (Set of String) Named project permissions from the server catalog.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-generated opaque role ID.
- `revision` (Number) Server revision for optimistic concurrency control.
- `slug` (String) Server-generated role slug.
